'''2011 Worlds Day 2 Jack McGuigan DS Spice Mine Operations''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Jack McGuigan]] at [[2011 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Deck name '''Spicy T's'''. Username '''Jbuggi18'''. Starting objective is line 8 (line 1 is Kessel). L14 written Slave 1. L17 sheet Lt. Hebsly (V); no Virtual Block page, Tie Hawk is not a card. L37 last digit cramped, entered DS-61-3. L40 sheet Black Leader (V) → DS-61-2 (V); L46 is DS-61-2 not (V). L53 written Binder, entered Binders (the device; the starship Binder also exists). L9 written Spice Mine Admin (V), entered Spice Mine Administrator (V); the office site is L2. Shield 5 written Coward. Shield 7 short “fire” word entered as Crossfire (not V). Shield 8 written Edeploy (V), entered Emergency Deployment (V) — an interrupt written in the shield block.

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Spice Mine Operations (V) (Virtual Block 6)|Spice Mine Operations (V)]]
